title: neutrino.semantic-feature-vocabulary
description: The CLOSED  semantic-requirement vocabulary: the finite set of <dimension>:<value> feature strings a verified CoordinationPlan may require, pinned to semanticProfileVersion. Emitted by `neutrino-translate --semantic-feature-vocabulary` from neutrino::knownSemanticFeatures() (the single source of truth) and byte-matched by CI; consumed by the target-profile validator, the bundle generator, and the released domain-pack verifier so no hand-maintained table drifts. Distinct from the OPEN  supportedFeatures namespace. Fail-closed (additionalProperties:false).

semanticProfileVersion.description: The closed semantic-profile contract version (VersionInfo.h kSemanticProfileVersion) this vocabulary is pinned to; a target profile pinned to a different version fails closed.

features.description: The closed, sorted, unique set of semantic-requirement feature strings.
